description: List tasks ready for your sign-off — shows completed builds waiting for approval or feedback. Does not call the Anthropic API.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of pending reviews to return. Omit to return all. Reserved for future pagination — current behaviour returns all pending regardless of value.

scope.description: Which reviews to show. Defaults to "relevant" (assigned to you or in your active cycle). Use "team" for the complete shared queue, separated by ownership.

name: review_list
